headline: Iran's president says his country has 'no trust' in U.S. in meeting with journalists
context: NPR's Steve Inskeep was part of a small group of journalists who met with an Iranian official on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly in New York. He tells Leila Fadel what he learned.
